about.title: Booking App
about.p1: The app helps you find and book a place to stay, wherever your trip takes you. Choose a destination, enter your dates, and within seconds you'll see real results.
about.p2: Every search runs in the background, so you never have to stare at a blank screen while you wait. As soon as the results are ready, you land straight on a list of hotels that match your search.
about.p3: Save the places you like with a tap of the heart and come back to them whenever you're ready to decide.
about.techIntro: This is a single-page application built with React 19 and bundled with Vite.
